data.name: Backyard Bayou
data.detailed_description:
Backyard Bayou is a fast, aggressive third-person roguelite shooter. Something ancient woke up in the swamp behind the cabin, and the old man living there has chores to do. He grabs the shotgun, steps off the porch, and goes to clear them out.

SOMETHING WOKE UP IN THE SWAMP

Tentacled horrors, corrupted creatures, and things that should not exist are crawling out of the bayou. Each trip drops you into a shifting stretch of swamp with no waves and no waiting. Enemies keep coming until you find the ritual site, summon whatever answers, put it down, and harvest the corpse. Then you do it again, deeper, against worse.

KEEP MOVING OR GET BURIED

Combat is built around momentum. The harder you fight and the faster you move, the stronger you get, and the swamp answers with more of everything. Dip, duck, dive, and dash your way through rising pressure. Standing still is how old men die.

BUILD SOMETHING THE SWAMP REGRETS

Every run is shaped by what you find. Stack items, chase synergies, and turn a tired old man into something the swamp should have left alone. Choose from over two dozen guns, a shed full of melee tools, and abilities that range from practical to profane. Chests, shrines, and stranger things are scattered through every trip, if you are willing to push away from the safe path to reach them.

GO DEEP ENOUGH AND IT NOTICES

Survive enough trips into the swamp and something big comes looking for a word. Defeat it and make a choice: take the win and end the run, or keep looping into harder territory to see how long an old man's luck holds. Runs land in the 20 to 30 minute range, quick enough to go again, long enough to build something ridiculous.

BRING A FRIEND

Online co-op in Early Access. Invite a Steam friend, split the loot, and clear the swamp together. Experimental for now, with more on the way.

KEY FEATURES

  • Fast third-person roguelite combat built around momentum and movement

  • No waves. Enemies spawn until the job is done

  • Over two dozen guns plus melee weapons and abilities, all with their own feel

  • Items stack and synergize into game-breaking builds

  • Explore, find the ritual site, summon the boss, harvest it, go again

  • Survive long enough to face the run boss, then choose: cash out or go deeper

  • Lovecraftian dread meets Louisiana bayou at dusk, creepy but never slow

  • Online co-op with a Steam friend (experimental, more to come)

  • Made by one person and a very patient old man

data.short_description: Don't you hate it when horrors beyond human comprehension show up in the backyard? Grab the shotgun and clear them out. A fast, aggressive third-person roguelite shooter where items stack into ridiculous builds and the swamp never runs out of things to shoot.
data.supported_languages: English, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB (Vulkan 1.0 required)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device works
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU. DirectX is not used.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 2060 / AMD RX 6700 XT
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any standard audio device works
  • Additional Notes: Requires Vulkan-compatible GPU. DirectX is not used.

content_descriptors.notes: Backyard Bayou is a third-person roguelite shooter set in a Lovecraftian swamp. The player fights off eldritch monsters using firearms and melee weapons. The game contains stylized, arcade-style violence against fictional creatures — including monster deaths and combat effects — alongside dark, eerie horror atmosphere and imagery. It does not contain sexual content, nudity, real-world drug or alcohol use, self-harm, or violence directed at real-world groups.
